origin: the fourth multiplier rose to 3.79 last round and the per-leg slip moved by less than 0.3 percent, and the training log showed why: max_slip_seen was pinned at 23.44 for all 48 updates while the evaluation measures 1.86. The ratio divides by max(forward speed, 0.05), so a cold start from rest makes the denominator a floor and every small foot speed becomes a 20-plus ratio. The multiplier was pushing on that startup artefact, not on stance dragging

change.training signal only: the constraint now uses an absolute stance-foot speed hinge with a speed gate: per leg the excess is max(0, v_stance - max(0.50 * |forward speed|, 0.02)) when |forward speed| >= 0.10, and max(0, v_stance - 0.02) below that, so at rest the allowance is a small absolute speed instead of a collapsing denominator
change.windowed: the violation is averaged over the rollout, force-weighted across the six legs, and enters the reward as minus the multiplier times that average; dual ascent 0.05 per rollout, lambda_max 50
change.gate untouched: the acceptance gate is still the frozen per-leg slip ratio with its 0.05 floor, measured exactly as before by the unchanged evaluator; only the training signal changes, and this is written down so no one can claim the gate was relaxed
change.kept: triad body with doubled torque, the pose re-solved for triad contact at COM 1.45, 1 ms policy tick, C = 0.02, releasable adhesion 0.25 body weight, mu 1.5, reward v4 without its ratio slip term (so the new signal is the only slip pressure), the three other constraints, 48 updates

prediction_stated_before_running: if the earlier null result was caused by the degenerate metric, the new multiplier should engage and the stance foot speed should fall during training; if the stance foot speed does not fall even with a clean signal, then the policy genuinely cannot keep a planted foot and the conclusion changes from a measurement defect to a behavioural one
labelling: derived body, derived actuator, derived adhesion, replacement ANN, engineered constraint; not frozen-body acceptance
accounting: per update: the multiplier, the windowed violation mean, the mean force-weighted stance foot speed, and the forward speed; both evaluation protocols with the unchanged gate
